text: Trigger I adopt: h1_close_above:bar_high, but only after a sign-of-strength day: a wide bar closing in its top third (clv_ge:0.67) on at least 1.2x its average volume (vol_x_ge:1.2) (R6, C12). That is the level 'once volume expands' lacks. Friday had none: day_vol 1.02, H1 pos_in_day_range_pct 13.9, D last bar red; supply took the day. Trend still up near the test (W and D swing_class HH/HL, D close_vs_swing_high_pct 3.68), so WAIT, not ACT_NOW. Wrong if a daily close below structure_shift_ref (C17).
